name: cache-guard
description: Warns before a cold prompt cache re-bills the whole context, and shows the cache state on the status line

gateUsd.title: Ask above (USD)
gateUsd.description: Ask before sending to a cold cache when re-writing the context would cost at least this much at API prices.

ttlMinutes.title: Assumed cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is assumed to live before any expiry has been observed; observed hits and misses adjust it.
